summary.text: Tracy Wheeler is the Republican candidate for Georgia State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent David Lucas Sr.

She won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary over Nancy Hicks, and she was the Republican nominee for Georgia House of Representatives District 128 in 2024, when incumbent Mack Jackson defeated her, 50.1% to 49.9%.

paragraphs.text: On August 5, 2026, the Hancock County Sheriff's Office arrested Wheeler at the Hancock County Courthouse in Sparta on two counts of aggravated assault, according to the sheriff's office chief investigator quoted by the Union-Recorder.

The charges stem from two separate incidents reported to have occurred in late June and early July at Amigo's Cove restaurant in Hancock County, and in the June 28 incident she is accused of brandishing a handgun at employees.

CBS News Atlanta reported on August 10 that court filings in a civil dispute over the restaurant allege she pointed a gun at the restaurant's co-owner and another employee, that Wheeler denied the allegations in the civil complaint, and that the civil claims and the criminal charges remained unresolved.
